scope: Source provenance and blind eligibility of the three previously bound 2E wood-carbon traces. No model fitting, no prediction lock, no terminal values, no change to the official databases.
operations: Check exact DOI and documented aliases in the active source catalogs and frozen phase-31 folds. Audit tracked pre-reservation artifacts with DOI, dataset DOI, title, and distinctive sample-label filters. Emit counts, paths and role flags only; do not print snippets or candidate outcome values.

Compare up to three primary public source locations for the fixed companion study and archive. Emit protocol categories, material reuse or test overlap flags and archive file roles only. Retain both papers and any related runs within one source cluster.

Check that 10% and 20% early-only traces meet the original minimum and that the approved encoder can represent unknown A/g without conversion or changing the feature contract. Record missing and conflicting fields separately.
decision: A verified absence of known training/exposure matches is limited to audited project artifacts. A distinct testing protocol or coherent family quarantine can support a prospective case series. Exposure or ambiguity in outcome role is a hold, never replaced with zero. Confirm one independent-of-training source family at most, zero formal external acceptance this round.
